E1.comment: These are sampled fractions at fixed S and A1, with differing repeated exposure. No extrapolation beyond the complete43000-image training role.

E2.comment: Patch shuffle preserves content within each tile but disrupts CNN neighborhoods. At4px it permutes intact ViT patches; self-attention without positions is permutation-equivariant, while learned absolute positions prevent exact invariance here. Measured differences are consistent with different spatial biases but do not isolate a single causal mechanism. All E2 leader changes are exploratory seed1 observations.

E3.comment: The three-seed conclusion concerns clean test at the validation-locked fraction. It does not confirm the single-seed E2 corruption leader changes.

resources.comment: Equal parameter count within tolerance does not imply equal compute, timing or optimization behavior. No general architecture ranking outside this recipe is claimed.
